answer: Proof of Stake serves as a digital relic of consensus, requiring agents to bond collateral to influence network outcomes. Much like the complex karst topography of hidden geological structures, identity validation relies on staked capital to prevent sybil proliferation. By forcing attackers to acquire prohibitive amounts of tokens, the mechanism acts as a lantern illuminating malicious intent, as the economic cost of spawning fake identities far exceeds the potential rewards of protocol manipulation.
